item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Junior Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
Atreum, per the required forum guidelines, please use the standardized template for concepts found here: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282684/required-reading:how-to-use-this-forum-ideas

Please remember to be mindful that the combined text of the last four sections1 of the template may not exceed 400 words. For convenience, authors can check wordcount using this site: https://wordcounter.net/

Once you have reviewed the guidelines, please edit your post to the correct format rather than creating a new thread, and if you are having trouble editing, click the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of your post. Please feel free to then reach out to a reviewer for your concept: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

Footnotes
1. Elevator Pitch, Central Narrative, Hook/Attention-Grabber, and Additional Notes

item.title: Re: Hi! This is the revised version of my idea, Please tell me your opinion. Thank you!
item.content:encoded: This could use some elaborating. It can only move its head and torso, but it's swift? Does it float around? The idea of an SCP that decays things is interesting, but it also making duplicates might be too much. Then again, it could make sense if it was absorbing the nutrients to clone itself. I don't see the need for it to be a statue of a human too, any kind of strange living creature could work. Either way, the idea could use some refinement, but it has good potential.

item.title: Hi! This is the revised version of my idea, Please tell me your opinion. Thank you!
item.content:encoded: A sculpture of a human, approximately 2 feet tall. It has keen sight despite having no eyes. It is swift despite having no limbs. It shows aggression at the morning, and immobility at night. It can move it's head, and torso. Every time a subject touches the sculpture, they will start to decay. It can make duplicates of itself, using it's body. It can make duplicates of itself by growing an instance at it's torso. The instance, even though it isn't fully grown, can also decay subjects. Every instance will have the decaying effect to subjects.
